paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southwest, west, northwest
title: [Cloud Forest, High Crag]
21021.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Thick, verdant tree ferns line the upper edge of this dank gully.  Both thick earth banks lean over, creating a dark, cave-like area.  Long strings of glowworms hang from above, giving off a soft luminescent light.  Tiny fungus gnats fly about from place to place, occasionally getting caught in the sticky threads.  The moist dirt easily gives way underfoot, releasing the scent of decomposing greenery.
title: [Cloud Forest, Glow Worm Gully]
21022.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Free from the constant cleansing thrust of a tidal current, the water of the pond abounds with a wide variety of aquatic life.  Golden and jungle perch share the liquid environment with short-finned eels, and freshwater algae produce colorful surface patches.  Deep croaks and high-pitched ribbits resound from beneath the shade of fruit-laden lilly-pilly trees.  The pond serves as a favored spot for the larger wildlife of the surrounding jungle to pause for a quiet drink.
title: [Cloud Forest, Still Pond]
21023.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: In this cluster of two dozen enormous banyans, it becomes difficult to distinguish what set of woody tubers belong to each specific tree as the makeshift trunks entwine freely.  Spreading round crowns of elliptical leaves cover the area above with a thick yellow-green canopy.  Much further below, aerial-generated roots dig shallowly into the earth to produce a thin surface network.  On some of the largest of these strangler figs, scaly grey bark has fallen off to expose a smooth black inner core.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southwest, northwest
title: [Cloud Forest, Giant Banyans]
21024.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Watery cascades end their downward journey into a wide streambed that constricts into a much narrower channel in one direction.  That strait courses through a thin cleft in the coastal cliffs, presumably to the ocean beyond.  Silt built up on the eastern side of the broad pool, where the flow into the tight runnel is completely cut off, has created an alluvial delta.  The fertile triangle boasts a plethora of ribbits that emanate from within an unparalleled variety of bulrushes and cattails.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, southwest
title: [Cloud Forest, Lower Falls]
21025.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The high sandstone cliffs, which bar direct access to the western ocean, are just visible here amid the abundant flora.  Small shrubs and ferns tenuously hold on by shallow roots up the side of those bluffs, but elsewhere the greenery runs rampant.  Covered with decaying matter dropped by the plants that rise upward from the earth, the forest floor is dark and lacking in intense color.  Insects, however, thrive here, including many varieties of ants.
title: [Cloud Forest, Cliffside]
21026.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Converging here in massive clumps above ground level, the tangled root systems of clustered trees result in hazardous footing.  Overhead, the leaf canopy filters out the faint light of the stars, making the sky darker than night itself and further complicating any visual detection of obstacles.  Masses of outwardly projecting rosewoods dangerously camouflage the edge of a sheer drop to the southeast, where the escarpment plummets vertically downward for an astounding distance.
title: [Cloud Forest, Shelf Divergence]
21027.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Amid the lushly verdant but unexpectedly treeless vegetation at this southernmost point of the rainforest, the spectacular sandstone cliffs of the western coast stand as a fully visible backdrop.  The roar of waves crashing unseen on the opposite side of the stone barrier provides a rhythmic cadence of constant sound, while the tang of saltwater saturates the scent and taste of the redolently humid air.  Densely packed ferns of every shape, texture, and hue dominate the surrounding landscape.
title: [Cloud Forest, Southern Cliffs]
21028.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Large boulders cropping up from under the camouflage of wild vegetation give evidence of the rockiness of the terrain at this southern edge of the forest.  The most massive of the exposed stones sits beside the fallen trunk of an uprooted tree, which serves as a perfect spot to sit and look out over a dizzying drop at the southwestern point of the area.  Woody liana vines coil around the surrounding upright trees, and brown mushrooms cluster close to their buttressed roots.
title: [Cloud Forest, Precipice]
21029.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Reaching out over a sloping cliff is a triangular flat rock bearded with a layer of moist, green moss.  Looking over the edge, the forest below stretches out in full view with many unique rock formations jutting out of the green canopy.  The warm mist from the rainforest rises up with a hazy glow.  A grove of thick-leafed trees proudly display their bright flowers and sweet fruit.
title: [Cloud Forest, Misty Lookout]
21030.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The river rages to the north of this small semicircular clearing, frothy water occasionally splashing against the muddy bank.  The shore is littered with various pieces of flotsam that have been rendered into unrecognizable lumps of wood.  A thick wall of tall trees stands imposingly to the south, seemingly barring any further passage into the dense jungle, save for two narrow muddy paths.  A blanket of mist and steam rising from the river obscures the tree canopy, giving the world an ethereal appearance.
title: [Shimmering Mists, Muddy Bank]
21031.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A muddy path snakes its way through the thick growth of brush and trees, providing barely enough walking room.  Any vision beyond ten paces is obscured by a dense wall of haze and fog.  Some vines hang lazily from trees, appearing as snakes in the mist.  To the southeast, a monstrous tree has been violently uprooted by some unknown force.  The resulting devastation of the fallen tree has opened up a narrow but treacherous trail that leads deeper into the misty jungle.
title: [Shimmering Mists, Fallen Tree]
21032.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A thick carpet of ash has turned this small area of jungle into a grey alien wasteland.  Bare and blackened trees stretch towards the hazy sky like scorched fingers, and fronds the size of giantmen lie scattered upon the ground, their surfaces dark and crumbling.  One large tree in particular has been completely split in two from root to top, and a wide circle of pitch black earth surrounds its ruined trunk.  A fallen tree limb arches over a stream, providing dry passage to the other side.
title: [Shimmering Mists, Wasteland]
21033.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Tendrils of silvery mist hover above the small stream that winds through this part of the jungle.  Like the tentacles of an octopus, the mist crawls along the ground, wrapping itself around the vine-covered trunks of the nearby trees.  Gigantic ferns uncoil their fronds, rivaling the size of the trees above them.  A large tree branch lies across the water, allowing dry passage to the northwest, while a natural rock bridge leads to the northeast.
title: [Shimmering Mists, Crossroads]
21034.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The soft ground inclines sharply, reaching upwards until finally breaking through the thick plane of mist surrounding the treetops.  Surrounding the small circle of earth is a view of nothing but haze, giving the illusion of floating among a wide stretch of clouds.  Bright rays of moonlight are instantly broken into hundreds of rainbows in the white mist below.  Echoes of rushing water floats through the air, and the rocky protrusions of a natural stone bridge jut from the earth to the southwest.
title: [Shimmering Mists, Hazy Horizon]
21035.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Gigantic boulders have been scattered throughout the trees like pebbles, their shiny and damp surfaces covered with moss and lichen.  The thick haze plays tricks with the light and makes some of the more distant stones appear to be hulking giants ready to strike.  Weaving between the stony debris is a tiny stream that slowly flows to the east, its trickling barely heard over the sounds of the wildlife.  Tiny silver fish and tadpoles dart about within the stream, ceaseless in their movement.
title: [Shimmering Mists, Jungle]
21036.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An immense rocky outcropping rises from the ground, its surface covered in moss and vines.  A large hollow has been carved out from one side of the rock by a bubbling pool of boiling water.  A large gush of water occasionally bursts from the pool, slamming the top of the outcropping, leaving the water to drip down and form a small stream that flows east and southeast.  Steam roils forth from the scalding liquid, leaving the air hot and humid.
title: [Shimmering Mists, Geyser]
21037.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A large basin of clear water, fed by a stream trickling in from the northwest, has created a small clearing in the thick stand of trees.  The water ripples calmly, tendrils of mist rising from the surface and joining the larger hazy shroud in the treetops.  A single shaft of light has managed to pierce the fog, focusing its bright gaze upon the center of the pool.  An eerie silence dominates the small area, a stark contrast to the cacophony of noises that permeates the rest of this jungle.
title: [Shimmering Mists, Serene Pool]
21038.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Giant fern fronds overlap the narrow trail, while heavy vines dangle low from the treetops, obscuring the path ahead and making movement in this area slow and difficult.  A hazy mist creeps along the muddy ground, disappearing into the heavy undergrowth filled with ferns and flowering shrubs.  The songs of wild birds fill the air from the canopy of trees high above, mingled with the occasional cry of some unknown creature.
title: [Shimmering Mists, Narrow Trail]
21039.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Five giant pillars of smooth grey stone stand in the center of this circular clearing.  Deep white sand covers the entire area, which is free of the trees and vegetation that grow around the perimeter.  Unlike the rest of the jungle, this area is strangely quiet, with only the occasional cry of birds heard in the distance.  A dense canopy of mist lingers around the pillars, obscuring the sky above.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southwest, west, northwest
title: [Shimmering Mists, Clearing]
21040.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A hazy mist clings to the trees here, making it difficult to see beyond arm's length while sharp-bladed shrubs cling to the narrow path's edge, offering a painful surprise to anyone that strays too far.  Tangled vines drape from the treetops above, offering camouflage for snakes and small monkeys that chatter noisily while they swing from branch to branch.
title: [Shimmering Mists, Monkey Trail]
21041.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Water streams between large moss-covered boulders at the edge of a cliff, forming a small waterfall that cascades to the valley floor below.  Lichen-draped trees grow right up to the cliff's edge, blocking much of the view.  Birds glide above the misty treetops below, their screeches partially blocked by the sound of rushing water.  Purple and white orchids grow in large clumps near the base of the trees, while small frogs rest on rocks by the water.
title: [Shimmering Mists, Waterfall]
21042.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dirt crumbles near the cliff's edge as the trail comes to a sudden halt, giving a breathtaking view of the valley floor below.  A few shrubs and trees cling for life in the rocky soil, waiting for the next rain to wash them down the sparsely vegetated hillside.  Colorful birds of blue and yellow fly above the misty canopy of green below, their screeches resonating throughout the area.
title: [Shimmering Mists, Valley View]
21043.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Soft grass grows underfoot as the trail between the trees widens and the misty haze lightens here making this part of the jungle brighter.  Shrub-sized clumps of amber and yellow orchids grow near the path intermingled with ferns and other vegetation.  Blue and white bumblebee orchids have rooted themselves in the decaying remains of a large fallen tree trunk, while flowering vines of purple and white drape from the branches overhead, splashing the area with vivid color.
title: [Shimmering Mists, Orchid Trail]
21044.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Devoid of the mist that covers most of the surrounding jungle, the sandy path ends abruptly in front of a sheer rock face that juts from the jungle floor.  Covered in flowering vines, it is a wall of deep green vegetation covered with white and purple blossoms.  Areas of the rock are clearly visible, as though someone or something had removed the growth.  High above, there appears to be natural cave openings weathered into the stone, but no way to access them from the ground below.
title: [Shimmering Mists, Rock Face]
21045.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sticky and thick, the oppressive air is an unwelcome companion beneath the cave-like jungle interior.  Overhead, leafy branches overlap to create a broad living roof that filters out most of the moons' beams.  Humming loudly, a large cloud of mosquitoes constantly searches for its next unsuspecting victim.  Dotting the jungle floor, unusual piles of sticks and webbing clump beneath large fern fronds.
title: [Cor'rah, Humming Cloud]
21046.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Darkness blankets the jungle floor, far from the moonlight's reach.  Insects swarm over a fallen log, the smell of fresh, damp soil mingling with the earthy scent of rotting wood.  Both high above and on the ground, all manner of creatures battle for any space not already occupied by greenery.  Knobby, blossom-laden trumpetvines spread over the thick trunks of towering trees, creating a symbiotic relationship between tree, vine, and the insects that the heavily perfumed vines attract.
title: [Cor'rah, Dark Jungle]
21047.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The terrain becomes increasingly more difficult to maneuver through as the density of vegetation increases.  The moistness of the oppressive environment is evident in the humidity, a product of the large amount of rain needed to maintain the lush surroundings.  Palm fronds dip low from their tall trunks, mingling with the tall grasses sprouting forth from the damp soil.  Fallen fruit, rotting amongst the decaying leaves that litter the ground, aid in the fertilizing of the soil beneath.
title: [Cor'rah, Fruit Trees]
21048.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Trees, vines, creepers, bushes, and tall grasses create a thick tangle of vegetation.  Rattan palms stretch long stems toward the sky, competing with coconut-bearing palms and hardy banana trees.  Curious monkeys screech and play amid the variety of tree branches, clearly at home high above the jungle floor.  Bamboo edges the area, its strong, graceful shoots whispering softly in the sporadic breezes.  Carpeting the ground, a snarl of pothinir grass helps insulate the already stifling, humid air.
title: [Cor'rah, Dense Jungle]
21049.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Barren by most jungle standards, the area has a charred and dead feel to it.  Tree trunks show their trial by fire with alligator-scale burn patterns running up their length.  Singed flowers and ash mix in the dark soil as the jungle begins to heal itself once more.  Hot, humid air barely circulates, and the oppressive atmosphere is heightened by the lack of jungle sounds.  Small glimpses of new life poke their way out of the ashen soil, a testament to the hardiness of the region.
title: [Cor'rah, Ruined Jungle]
21050.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Creeping vines hang low, their lengths decorated by vividly hued orchid blossoms.  Coiled around a low-lying branch, poison green snakes lie motionless, their coloring providing nearly perfect camouflage until they slither away.  High overhead, two-toed sloths slowly but frequently make their way along a woody liana vine.  Infrequent breezes limp through the excessively humid air, the short-lived moments of relief from the oppressive heat a welcome torture.
title: [Cor'rah, Jungle Grove]
21051.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Amid the fluttering of several stray hummingbirds, patterns of light and dark fleck the ground where the moonlight is able to penetrate the profusion of heavily branched trees.  Thin blades of blue line almost every inch of the trees and ground where thousands of butterflies rest beneath the humid air.  Delicate blossoms have twisted closed, waiting for the warmth and light of day to awaken them as others bloom vibrantly in the slightly cooler night air.

Patterns of light and dark fleck the ground where the sunlight is able to penetrate the profusion of heavily branched trees.  Waves of blue appear and disappear along almost every inch of the trees and ground as thousands of butterflies rest beneath the humid air.  With every beat of the butterflies' wings, the jungle appears to take deep cleansing breaths.  Flitting in and out, small hummingbirds raid nectar-rich blossoms high in the jungle canopy.
title: [Cor'rah, Butterfly Glen]
21052.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Shimmering moonlight streams down from a star-studded sky to cover the area with a gentle light.  Fallen trees ring the area, their loss creating an opening for sweetly scented breezes to sweep through.  Various shades of green compete with vivid colors exploding up and down the trunks of trees.  Low chirrups echo through the still air, the mating call of numerous frogs accenting the low chatter of unseen animals.  Cradled by sturdy branches, a small clouded leopard lazes beneath a shelter of leaves.
title: [Cor'rah, Jungle Atrium]
21053.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Though immersed in the darkness of night, the air retains a dense, moist heat.  No hint of the sky can be seen through the compact leafy canopy, and what little light sneaks through is barely enough to illuminate the slick vegetation and moist loamy ground.  Massive tree roots crisscross the jungle floor, their length mirroring the crosshatching of abundant, leaf-laden branches high above.  Soft dripping sounds echo eerily in the otherwise still air.
title: [Cor'rah, Jungle Thicket]
21054.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Evidence of the regular bouts of rain that supply the jungle with much needed nutrients, several small pools of water have formed in the hollows of fallen trees and among the foliage.  Mosquitoes buzz around the surface of each one, and the occasional frog immerses itself under the liquid.  The rich soil of the jungle floor is moist and difficult to travel through, though the leaves scattered about the ground provide a bit of traction.
title: [Cor'rah, Rainforest]
21055.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Fallen leaves dot the rich soil in piles of no certain pattern, their wet, decaying presence adding a musty smell to the stale and humid air.  Flowers bloom from creeping vines wrapped around the trunks of various trees, their exotic hues providing a splash of striking color against the lush, verdant surroundings.  An occasional butterfly or hummingbird flutters near them, partaking of the sweet nectar they provide, before moving on to the next.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, south, southwest
title: [Cor'rah, Creeping Jungle]
21056.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Thousands of trees compete for space as far as the eye can see.  High overhead, small fruit bats glide continually from branch to branch, their movements giving a sense of rhythm to the jungle surrounds.  Bright light is at a premium here, the convergence of foliage far above casting deep shadows and blotting out much of the moons' pale beams.  Enormous ferns stretch out feathery blades, each leaf adorned with tiny drops from one of the jungle's many brief downpours.
title: [Cor'rah, Jungle Copse]
21057.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Towering over the area, a huge brush box tree creates a stunning green canopy dotted with snowy white flowers.  The flaring buttress arches up, creating a tunnel large enough to walk through.  Circling the base of the tree, several bird's nest ferns proudly display their yellow-green fronds, which fan over the sparse vegetation that carpets the moist forest floor.
title: [Cloud Forest, Clearing]
21058.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sourced in the northern river, cascades of water slide past a narrow gully before falling further down to the delta basin.  The rocky promontory above protects this small cavern hollowed out of the highland by the channel.  Though sheets of water curtain the cave mouth, access points, one to the west up a ridge toward the coastal cliffs, and the other to the southwest across a splash-washed land bridge toward the lowland, make it possible for both predator and prey to roam this space at will.
title: [Cloud Forest, Upper Falls]
21059.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Jutting out of the massive sandstone rise that protects the coastline, a spur circles to the east around one edge of a spectacular river-sourced waterfall.  Above that lateral ridge, the cliffs themselves rise in majestic verticality.  Forest trees and underbrush, however, impede full sight of the scope of their grandeur.  Grey eucalypti, perfectly content to stretch long roots into the sedimentary rock of the environs, lend the uniquely crisp scent of their foliage to the moisture-laden air.
title: [Cloud Forest, Northern Cliffs]
21060.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Flowing with a quiet murmur, a small stream breaks free of a nearby pool, casually cascading over ground that quickly drops into a steeped valley.  From this vantage point, the valley's lush growth is visible in the moonlight, its wealth in life obvious not only in the spread of trees, but also in the sheer volume of squawking, buzzing, grunting, and rustling that fills the night air and echoes up the valley.
21061.location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon
title: [Veiled Stream, Valley View]

assignment.location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

21061.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Firewheel trees and jambu spread their limbs, their foliage covered in colorful flora, their roots firmly planted near the edge of the river that tumbles by.  In one direction, moonlit sandstone cliffs rise up above the forest, their light color contrasting sharply with the darker shades of the night jungle.  To the other side, only ferns and trees are visible as they block out a full view of the sky.
21062.location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon
title: [Alhan'aht River, Rooted Bank]

assignment.title: [Alhan'aht River, Rooted Bank]
assignment.location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

21062.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Reflecting the moonlight with their pale color, spectacularly tall sandstone cliffs cause the rainforest to come to an abrupt dead-end, blocking out any further growth, save for the vines that climb up the cliffs and hang down with invitation to climb up.  The rushing river hurtles straight out through a single wide gap in the cliff, quickly disappearing out of sight.
21063.location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon
title: [Alhan'aht River, Coastal Gap]

assignment.title: [Alhan'aht River, Coastal Gap]
assignment.location: the environs of the Saewehna Lagoon

21063.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Widening perceptively to the south, the river flows at a steady pace to its destination in the north.  Rough muddy banks rise from the edge of the water course and are choked with verdant vines.  Several tendrils dangle from the trees above to create a colorful curtain that is laden with fragrant white jasmines.  The rise and fall of frogs chirping is punctuated by the steady hum of insects throughout the area.
title: [Alhan'aht River, Southern Pass]
21064.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Swiftly moving, the river cascades through the landscape, creating a soft musical sound as it passes by several tall river reeds.  The melodic sound of their hollow interiors clacking against each other echoes through the area and is punctuated by the soft sound of bird song and the delicate chirp of birds.  Curving slightly, the water smoothly circles around an enormous banyan tree that has taken root in the western banks.
title: [Alhan'aht River, Southern Pass]
21065.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Tiny whirlpools form in the dark waters of the river, their creation testament to its swift passage as it courses through the jungle on its way to the north.  Small channels along the muddy banks break away from the main body of the river to create minor tributaries that wind their way into the dark green jungle, only to rejoin the river further down.
title: [Alhan'aht River, Southern Pass]
21066.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Rocks along the southwestern banks create a barricade that directs the swiftly flowing river into a northerly direction and causes the dark waters to slightly foam as they collide with the smooth protrusions.  The banks rise on either side of the water course and grow less muddy to the east, while the western edge is riddled with heavy vines and rabbit's foot fern.
title: [Alhan'aht River, Southern Pass]
21067.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Jungle plants grow sparse through this section of the river as it glides away from the slow rise of hills.  Large and small boulders pock-mark the river bank where the water disperses outward, its passage creating a soft burbling sound as it leaves the main tributary for the more wild, marshy land.
title: [Alhan'aht River, Hilly Pass]
21068.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Following the contours of the land, the river winds its lazy way through the hills as it makes its slow progress to its northern destination.  Blue, brown, and orange granite rises to either side of the water course to create a roofless tunnel that displays various wavy lines where the water has eroded the land to create its current home.
title: [Alhan'aht River, Hilly Pass]
21069.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Roughly churning, the river carves a path through the smooth granite bedrock that is the foundation of the surrounding hills.  Dips and gullies cause the water to drop from various heights as it moves in a northern direction away from the large mountain that looms in the southwest.
title: [Alhan'aht River, The Divide]
21070.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sharp angles and dark lines divide the Alhan into its two tributaries, the Alhan'aht, which continues its passage to the north, and the Alhan'naht, which continues its tumbling passage to the south.  Frothing as it leaves its sister, the river tumbles in white-capped brilliance through the rough rocks that line its banks.
title: [Alhan'naht River, The Divide]
21071.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Moving at a swift pace, the river glides past the large and small boulders that create its rough banks.   Moonlight slants at angles through the rough canopy overhead and glistens upon the crystal clear waters, while verdant vines and broad-leafed ferns take root on the distant edges.
title: [Alhan'naht River, Jungle Pass]
21072.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Careening into the eastern banks, the river rises high against the smooth granite wall that causes it to bend to the south.  Mangroves and banyan trees clog the western rise, their verdant leaves creating deep shadows throughout the passage.
title: [Alhan'naht River, Jungle Pass]
21073.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The narrow passage of the river's northern edges widens here, causing the rough waters to become sluggish as they tumble towards the south.  Muddy banks rise upon either side, and while the eastern banks are choked with thick vines and wild shrub, the western banks are free of brush.  White-flowered arrowhead plants are painted with burgundy hues, their long stems surrounded by broad leaves as they make their home at the river's edge.
title: [Alhan'naht River, Jungle Pass]
21074.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dark boulders rise out of the wide river along the southern end, their thick and sturdy angles neatly bisecting the water course in half.  The western edge continues to amble peacefully through the jungle, while the eastern edge picks up speed and rushes off towards the distant, thunderous sound of water falling from a great height.  A series of thick hemp nets stretches across the eastern passage, preventing travel in that direction.  The nets are clogged with logs, twigs, and other debris.
title: [Alhan'naht River, Jungle Pass]
21075.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Falling away from the foothills, the river tumbles through the forest.  A dense haze clings to the chillier surface of the water as it passes through the choking humidity of the jungle and draws the attention of small flying insects.  The delicate hum of the winged beasts fills the air.
title: [Alhan'naht River, Jungle Pass]
21076.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Flanked by congested trees upon the eastern shores, the river ambles through the thick jungle vegetation and murmurs softly as it passes.  Giant water lilies cling to the western banks, their amethyst hues reflected in the water.
title: [Alhan'naht River, South Wilds]

description: Sheltered in the heart of town and amidst a grove of trees, this earthy structure beckons visitors with an intricately carved pair of oak doors. Two smaller outbuildings are visible around the circumference, their rounded exteriors radiating outward to match the arc of the main structure.  The triskelion architecture of the lodge is clearly discernable in the lichen-covered riverstone foundation.

Against one wall, a long sideboard offers food and drink.  A glass panel leads out to a lush garden.

description: Carved into the oak panels of the far wall, a graceful tree of life spreads its branches.  Polished stone familiars are evenly spaced around the room. To the east of the entry, three paintings in gilded frames and an incongruous boar's head hang above the familiars.  To the west, the curved wall bears two plaques, one silver plaque and one gold plaque, hung side by side on the smooth oak paneling.

description: The glaesineth-enclosed deck has a small door leading out and a brass-edged koa gangplank climbing up to a second-story door.  Small openings at the top of each wall let in the sea air, and their transparent nature allows an unfettered view of the dunes and ocean.  An anchor-topped coil of hempen rope sits neatly in one corner, the anchor polished to a high sheen.  Painted onto the artfully sea-weathered wood of the wall is "Welcome to the Vengeful Siren!" with a brass ship's bell hanging next to it.
